final: SELECT s2.riskeval AS riskeval, AVG(s1.gbsize * 1.0 / s1.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans s1 JOIN sites s2 ON s1.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry WHERE s1.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s1.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s1.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s1.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s1.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s2.riskeval
